context_for_next_testing_agent: Clara CLI fully expanded with ~45 commands across 8 categories. All commands tested via POST /api/cli/execute with {main_site_id, command}. Categories: General (/commands, /help, /clear), Roles (/roles list|permissions|compare|repair|reset-all), Users (/users info|sessions|search), Firewall (/firewall scan|status|block|unblock), Site (/site features|demo|stats), Environment (/env list|assign|sites), License (/license packages|info), Logs (/logs cli), System (/db stats|/whoami|/health). Environment admin assignment tested via POST /api/environments/{env_id}/admins.

/commands - All 8 Categories.details: Shows General, Roles, Users, Firewall, Site, Environment, License, Logs, System categories

/roles list.details: Shows 8 roles with permission counts (e.g., admin 20/20 perms)

/roles permissions admin.details: Shows permission matrix with View/Create/Edit/Delete columns

/roles compare admin editor.details: Shows differences between roles with diff count

/roles repair.details: Creates missing default roles or confirms all present

/roles reset-all.details: Resets all roles to default permissions

/users info <email>.details: Shows detailed user info with all site access

/users search <query>.details: Finds users by name or email

/firewall scan.details: Shows 2FA coverage, stale accounts, admin warnings

/firewall status.details: Shows blocked IPs, events, failed logins

/firewall block/unblock.details: Block and unblock IP addresses work correctly

/site stats.details: Shows document counts (416 shows, 10 users, etc.)

/health.details: Shows comprehensive health check with multiple components

Environment Admin API.details: POST /api/environments/{env_id}/admins successfully adds users as environment admins

Frontend CLI Panel.details: CLI toggle button visible, panel opens, input works, output displays correctly
